verdict.rationale: USPTO documents a form previews page where TEAS forms can be viewed without logging in, so the forms can be inspected before the account wall. The evidence does not show the forms or their instructions can be downloaded, and filing itself requires a verified USPTO.gov account. missing for 10: evidence that forms are downloadable (not just previewable), evidence that form instructions are available without an account, patent-side form access, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account

citations.quote: You can preview TEAS forms without logging in on our form previews page.
the forms are inspectable before the account wall
